Commit ownership projections atomically and retain acknowledged recovery credits

Bound foreign inventory adoption by observed external-flow capacity while owned credits remain. Recover unsettled credits when attributed fees and aggregate positions corroborate them, including corrections to provisional closures. Keep cycle changes, activity checkpoints and audits in one transaction with version checks.
